capabilities.claim: Generates named surface_graph surfaces with stable ids and role metadata for open and closed radial reference impellers.
V0.91 root transition topology uses pressure-root and suction-root transition surfaces per blade.
Blocking validation failures prevent STL, OBJ, and STEP export.
V0.91 declares shared-node transition patch mesh output for review-grade transition inspection.
STEP export writes bounded unsewn review faces from surface_graph samples; it is not an industrial exact sewn B-Rep solid.
V0.91 does not produce solver-ready CFD volume meshes.
Expert feedback can be linked to surfaces, rules, and cases, but is not automatically converted into constructor rule patches.
